function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The treatment group has a significantly higher proportion of severe cases (41.25%) compared to the control group (4.92%), while the control group has a higher proportion of mild cases (71.59% vs. 20.31%). To correct for this, we used standardization: the adjusted treatment rate was computed by applying the treatment group's response rates across severity levels to the control group's severity distribution.
